description: HPKE public key encryption (RFC 9180), in pure V: the X25519 DH KEM (composed with gil_silva.x25519), the HKDF-based context KDF over the standard library and the ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD (composed with gil_silva.chacha20poly1305), for all four protocol modes, plus the export-only AEAD (0xffff).
name: gil-silva.hpke
